content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: org-rate-spike detected for org `crimson-lane` (org_id: org_9c3). 5m error rate -> 429 increase, token QPS > quota. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/org-rate-spike

oncall-alex: taking this. tagging @sre-mari and @customer-success-jordan

sre-mari: on it. quick checks: 1) Which pool are they routed to? 2) Any recent deploys?

eng-runtime: crimson-lane traffic hitting dedicated-pool-7 (nv4). No deploys in last 24h. Seeing lots of short-lived chats with long context.

oncall-alex: looks like our RL agent started returning 429s after quota burn. Can we apply emergency soft bump for this org while we triage?

ops-bot: Current org config: `soft_qps: 120`, `hard_qps: 150`, `burst: 200`. 5m avg qps: 210, 95th: 380.

sre-mari: propose temporary change -> soft_qps: 400, hard_qps: 800 for 30m, then auto-revert. Anyone object?

eng-runtime: +1 for quick bump. also enable prefix KV caching for their route to cut downstream tokens. We can flip caching flag without restart.

oncall-alex: doing the change now. PATCH command going to admin console: ```
PATCH /admin/orgs/org_9c3/rate_limit
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "soft_qps": 400,
  "hard_qps": 800,
  "auto_revert_minutes": 30,
  "reason": "emergency QPS bump for live spike - triage in progress"
}
```

ops-bot: API response: 200 OK. New config applied. :white_check_mark:

customer-success-jordan: Notifying Crimson Lane CS lead now: "We're applying a temporary limit increase while we investigate. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

sre-mari: immediate metrics: request 429s dropping from 18% -> 2% in 90s. Latency stable. Good signal.

oncall-alex: added a temporary traffic-shaper rule to limit per-session burst to 250 tokens to avoid cache thrash. Command: ```
rbctl traffic-shaper set --org org_9c3 --per-session-burst 250 --duration 30m
```

eng-runtime: enabling KV prefix caching on route `crimson-lane/chat` now. Should reduce repeated context expansion.

oncall-alex: paging SRE on-call handoff in 20m. I'll document steps and current state for next oncall. Key notes: bump applied, traffic-shaper enabled, KV caching on, CS notified.

customer-success-jordan: Customer responded: "Thanks — we're doing a job that spiked. Appreciate the fast lift. We'll throttle from our side too."

sre-mari: plan: 1) monitor for 30m while we assess root cause 2) if stable, revert soft limits to conservative level (150/300) and propose session token limits + model quantization guidance 3) postmortem with customer and product in 48h

oncall-alex: creating incident ticket in ops: INC-2026-1423, adding runbook steps, attaching graphs. I'll hand off to next oncall (pager-duty) at 00:20 UTC.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: auto-revert will run at +30m unless extended.

pager-duty: picked up handoff. Acknowledge. I have the runbook and will watch through the revert window. Ping me if we need a persistent quota change.

oncall-alex: thanks. tagging for follow-up: @eng-runtime (for caching/perf follow-up), @product (impact assessment), @customer-success-jordan (customer comms). Closing active paging for now. :lock_with_key:
